instruction: From now on, whenever you put a pen in my pen case, turn the pen so that it lines up with the long side of the case before you lower it. Please put the blue pen in the green pen case now.

attempts.code:
go_home()
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

# Check if green_case is occupied
case_spots = free_spots("green_case")
if case_spots["occupants"]:
    # Remove the object in the case first
    # Find a free spot to place the current object
    case_spots = free_spots("green_case", "blue_pen")
    if not case_spots["spots"]:
        # No free spot; assume we can still place it if we remove the current one
        # Grasp the object inside the case
        case_obj = case_spots["occupants"][0]
        candidates = grasp_candidates(case_obj)
        if candidates:
            candidate = candidates[0]
            grasp(candidate)
            # Move to a safe spot to drop
            carry_to(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
            open_gripper()
            retreat()
            # Now the case is empty

# Now grasp the blue pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
candidate = candidates[0]
grasp(candidate)

# Find a free spot in the green_case
case_spots = free_spots("green_case", "blue_pen")
spot = case_spots["spots"][0]
x, y = spot["x"], spot["y"]

# Carry to the spot with correct orientation
# The pen's long axis should align with the case's long axis (0.444)
# At grasp, pen's long_axis_yaw is 0.399, so we need to rotate by (0.444 - 0.399) = 0.045
delta_yaw = case["long_axis_yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"]
carry_to(x, y, height=0.18, yaw=None)
rotate_by(delta_yaw)

# Lower until contact
lower_until_contact()

# Release
open_gripper()
retreat()

# Check
check("blue_pen", "green_case")
